review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: One might argue that using computer can help people see historical objects and works of art, so public museums and art galleries will be no longer needed. In this essay, however, I am to refute this school of thought.

Admittedly, technology has beneficial cultural and historical experience. This is predicated on the assumption that technology brings high-resolution images, three-dimensional reconstructions and virtual reality platforms, this enable viewers to explore masterpieces and ancient artefacts in remarkable detail and without living home. For example, Louvre museum, which one of the most famous museum in the world, has offers some of websites that helps people around the world explore masterpieces and with no cost or a little payment. Those help people who cannot afford or have mobility issues can still access a vast range of cultural and historical heritages.

However, I strongly believe that public museums and art galleries are essential. Initially, online experience cannot replicate the direct sensory engagement of seeing an artefact or artworks in person, this evoke emotions and a sense of authenticity that digital images cannot convey. A clear example is that experienced about a historical museum, you can see and touch ancient artefacts in your own, have direct sensory engagement, this are things that online experience does not have. Furthermore, museums and galleries are vital cultural hubs that symbolize the identity of a region, this is a magnet for tourism and a facilitator of bonding within the community.

In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that technology can help people get a good experience about cultural and historical. However I believe that museums and galleries are necessary and cannot be replace.

review.overall: Em triển khai đủ hai phía: công nghệ giúp người xem tiếp cận từ xa, còn bảo tàng cho trải nghiệm trực tiếp và vai trò cộng đồng. Mở bài dùng One might argue đúng để nêu quan điểm sẽ bị phản bác. Tuy nhiên, mức tự soát câu chưa đạt: em lặp dấu phẩy ghép mệnh đề và các dạng động từ sai như 'has offers', 'this enable', 'cannot be replace'. Ví dụ 'experienced about a historical museum' chưa thành câu rõ và giả định khách được chạm hiện vật không chắc đúng. Em cần sửa nghiêm túc từng lỗi và kiểm tra lại trước khi nộp bản viết lại.

paragraphs: One might argue that using a computer can help people see historical objects and works of art, leading some to believe that public museums and art galleries will be no longer needed. In this essay, however, I refute this school of thought.

Admittedly, technology offers beneficial cultural and historical experiences. This is predicated on the assumption that high-resolution images, three-dimensional reconstructions and virtual reality platforms enable viewers to explore masterpieces and ancient artefacts in remarkable detail without leaving home. For example, Louvre museum, which is one of the most famous museums in the world, offers online tours that help people around the world explore masterpieces at little or no cost. These online tours enable people who cannot afford a museum visit or have mobility issues to access a vast range of cultural and historical heritages.

However, I strongly believe that public museums and art galleries are essential. Initially, online experience cannot replicate the direct sensory engagement of seeing an artefact or artworks in person. Seeing an artefact in person evokes emotions and a sense of authenticity that digital images cannot convey. For example, when visitors enter a historical museum, they can see ancient artefacts with their own eyes. Viewing their size and details up close can help visitors connect with the past in a way that an online image cannot. Furthermore, museums and galleries are vital cultural hubs that symbolize the identity of a region. It naturally follows that these places attract tourists and facilitate bonding within the community.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that technology can help people gain cultural and historical experiences. However, I believe that museums and galleries are necessary and cannot be replaced.

task.text:
Some people claim that public museums and art galleries will be no longer needed because people can see historical objects and works of art by using a computer.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
